Name: Lavender Springs Farm
Author: lanterncat
Description:
Mod Features:
﻿By default, replaces the Standard farm; this can be changed to another farm type in the config.
﻿Has a new farm cave with a usable minecart. Crops can also be planted anywhere in it.
﻿Includes a separate area on the left that has a pool for stamina regeneration.

Now features support for Eemie's Just a New Map Recolor. Generate a config and in the recolor field type either "Eemie GreenFall" or "Eemie OrangeFall".
To use with other farmcave maps, generate a config and set UseThisModsCave to False.

[b]Mod Compatibility:[/b]
[b]Compatible with: [/b]SVE, Karmylla's Immersive Maps
[b]﻿Mostly Compatible with:[/b] Stardew Valley Reimagined 2, Expanded Access Maps (warps back to the farm are somewhat off)
